initiative.name: TS→Rust Migration — Stage 6: Behavioral Parity Verification
initiative.objective: Verify all 6 ported Rust crates for behavioral parity against their TypeScript originals. 6 verifier teammates run in parallel — one per crate. Produce a unified verification report.

teammates.name: verifier-tui
teammates.objective: Verify night-agent-runner-tui for behavioral parity with the tui-repl subsystem. Confirm all screens and components render equivalently.

teammates.name: verifier-cli
teammates.objective: Verify night-agent-runner-cli for behavioral parity with the command-surface subsystem. Confirm all CLI commands have equivalent Clap implementations.

teammates.name: verifier-core
teammates.objective: Verify night-agent-runner-core for behavioral parity. Focus on QueryEngine semantics, session state round-trips, and compaction pipeline correctness.

teammates.name: verifier-plugins
teammates.objective: Verify night-agent-runner-plugins: Plugin trait coverage, skill implementations, and output style parity.

teammates.name: verifier-integrations
teammates.objective: Verify night-agent-runner-integrations: MCP client correctness, message serialization, and protocol compliance.

teammates.name: verifier-remote
teammates.objective: Verify night-agent-runner-remote: TCP server, WebSocket, SSH tunnel, and upstream proxy behavioral correctness.

doneCriteria: pnpm exec nx run-many -t typecheck,test,build --projects=agent-runner-rust passes
